work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief LI transfers Bishop Joseph Carew from the Madras coadjutorship to the Bengal vicariate, with mandate clause and dating clause. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF13170–13170; the source dating clause at LF13241–13244 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima secunda novemb. millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo, ponti- ficatus Nostri anno decimo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
